title: pannadata pipeline
about: How the football data gets from Opta to the site's R2 store, on GitHub Actions: the daily Opta scrape here, then the ratings and match predictions in the panna repo (see that repo's pipeline guide), then the blog data build here, which publishes what the site reads. Each stage starts the next by sending a repository_dispatch message; this guide times each stage on its own and does not follow one chain of runs across repos.

pipelines.name: Daily Opta scrape
pipelines.about: Fetches new Opta matches for the current season, merges them into the consolidated tables, scores new shots for xG and post-shot xG (xGOT), and publishes everything to the opta-latest release. Only the scheduled runs are counted, not manual backfills. Tuesday to Sunday it scrapes competition tiers 1 and 2; Monday it scrapes every tier (the scrape limit rises from 35 to 120 minutes), so Monday runs are the slow ones.
pipelines.triggers: GitHub's own schedule, set for 4pm Sydney time each day in summer. GitHub starts it hours late (the five runs used began between midnight and 3am Sydney time). When it succeeds it sends opta-scrape-complete to the panna repo, which starts both the Predictions Pipeline and the Opta RAPM/SPM Pipeline there.

jobs.name: scrape
jobs.about: One job: restore the data already on the opta-latest release, scrape what is new, rebuild the consolidated tables, score shots, upload, then start the panna repo

steps.name: Set up job
steps.about: GitHub starts the machine and downloads the actions this job uses

steps.name: Checkout pannadata
steps.about: Downloads this repo's code onto the machine

steps.name: Setup Python
steps.about: Installs Python 3.11 with a cache of the pip packages

steps.name: Install Python dependencies
steps.about: Installs the scraper's Python packages from scripts/opta/requirements.txt

steps.name: Restore opta-latest from GitHub Releases
steps.about: Downloads the manifest of matches already scraped and the consolidated tables (player stats, shots, events, lineups, fixtures and the per-league events files) from the opta-latest release, so this run adds to them instead of starting empty; fails if a file that should be there is missing

steps.name: Run Opta scraper
steps.about: Runs scripts/opta/scrape_opta.py: asks the Opta API for matches not yet in the manifest (the latest season of each competition; tiers 1 and 2, or every tier on Mondays) and saves one small parquet file per match, league and table

steps.name: Scrape stats job summary
steps.about: Writes a table of what the scrape fetched, per league and season, onto the run's summary page

steps.name: Build consolidated parquet files
steps.about: Runs scripts/opta/consolidate_opta.py: merges the new per-match files into the single opta_*.parquet tables and the per-league events files, one league at a time to save memory, and rebuilds opta-catalog.json

steps.name: Verify events_consolidated coverage vs player_stats
steps.about: Runs scripts/opta/check_events_coverage.py: stops the run before upload if any league's events file is missing more than 20 matches that the player stats have, for the current season

steps.name: Setup R for xG enrichment
steps.about: Installs R for the shot scoring below

steps.name: Install R dependencies for xG
steps.about: Installs the R packages the shot scoring needs (arrow, dplyr, xgboost, data.table, cli)

steps.name: Enrich shots with xG + xGOT
steps.about: Fills in shots that are missing details and scores them: repairs shot rows from the stored events, adds goalmouth placement, then downloads the xG v5 and xGOT v3 models from the models release and scores shots with no value yet (scripts/score_shots_context.R); an error here is recorded and fails the run at the end, after the upload

steps.name: Build player profiles (DOB/nationality/height)
steps.about: Runs scripts/opta/build_player_profiles.py: one row per player with date of birth, nationality and height, taken from the reep register because Opta's feed has none of them (best effort; a failure does not fail the run)

steps.name: Upload to GitHub Releases
steps.about: Uploads the consolidated tables, the event-less match list, the catalog and only the events files that changed this run to the opta-latest release; the match manifest goes up last, and only if every earlier upload worked, followed by bus_manifest.json

steps.name: Summary
steps.about: Prints the manifest size and the number of files built

steps.name: Build current club squads
steps.about: Runs scripts/opta/build_squads.py to build squads.parquet (who is at each club right now) and uploads it to opta-latest; best effort, keeping the old file if it fails

steps.name: Trigger panna predictions pipeline
steps.about: Sends opta-scrape-complete to the panna repo, which starts its predictions and ratings runs (tries three times)

steps.name: Fail on failed fixture windows
steps.about: Ends the run red if any fixture window failed on its first page (an Opta outage or rate limit), after everything else has been published

steps.about: Clean-up for an earlier step (saves caches, removes credentials)

pipelines.name: Blog data build
pipelines.about: Takes the ratings and predictions the panna repo published, joins them to the Opta data, builds the parquet files the site reads, and uploads them to the R2 store (inthegame-data, football folder). Only runs started by the panna repo's predictions-complete message are counted.
pipelines.triggers: The panna repo's Predictions Pipeline sends predictions-complete when it finishes publishing (a step near the end there). It can also be started by hand. It starts nothing else: the site reads the R2 files it uploads. It shares a queue with the daily scrape, so the two never write R2 at the same time.

jobs.name: build
jobs.about: One job: download the published ratings, predictions and Opta tables, rebuild each blog file, upload them to R2, then check nothing expected is missing

steps.name: Set up job
steps.about: GitHub starts the machine and downloads the actions this job uses

steps.name: Run actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
steps.about: Downloads this repo's code onto the machine

steps.name: Run r-lib/actions/setup-r@f9a764fea8d5c63df6ef9a5c7795bf7deb5d7e05
steps.about: Installs R

steps.name: Run r-lib/actions/setup-r-dependencies@f9a764fea8d5c63df6ef9a5c7795bf7deb5d7e05
steps.about: Installs the R packages this repo needs (from a cache when it can)

steps.name: Download source data
steps.about: Downloads from the ratings-data, blog-latest and opta-latest releases: the ratings, predictions, game logs, World Cup files, team strength, shot events, lineups and club squads that the builds below read; fails if a required one is missing

steps.name: Enrich shot xG (belt-and-suspenders — re-run if upstream is stale)
steps.about: Safety check: if more than 15% of the latest season's shots have no xG, fails the build under the current model setting (re-run the daily scrape to fix it); skipped when xG is healthy

steps.name: Build ratings parquet
steps.about: Runs scripts/build_blog_data.R: builds ratings.parquet, the player ratings table (xRAPM, SPM, career panna, EPR, PSR and the combined Piero rating) the site's player pages use

steps.name: Enrich WC squads with Piero
steps.about: Copies each World Cup squad player's career ratings and Piero rating from ratings.parquet, so the squads match it exactly

steps.name: Build player details parquet
steps.about: Runs scripts/build_player_meta.R: one row per player with their team, league and most common position

steps.name: Enrich shots with xGOT
steps.about: Under the current model setting this only prints that xGOT comes from the daily scrape and does nothing else

steps.name: Build weak-foot table (live xG)
steps.about: Builds shot-foot-history.json: each player's right-footed and left-footed shots so far, which the live xG scorer on the site needs

steps.name: Build shot parquet
steps.about: Runs scripts/build_shot_data.R: recent shots with xG for the site's shot charts

steps.name: Download and filter player skills
steps.about: Downloads opta_skills.parquet and keeps only the latest season, as player-skills.parquet

steps.name: Build match-shots (xG from enriched source)
steps.about: Builds match-shots.parquet: every shot in the blog's competitions plus the World Cup, with team names and the half it was taken in

steps.name: Build match-stats per league
steps.about: Runs scripts/rebuild_match_stats.R: one match-stats parquet per league (and per World Cup, Euro, Copa America and AFCON), one league at a time to save memory

steps.name: Build league xG from match-shots
steps.about: Builds league-xg.parquet and one team-match xG file per league from the shots

steps.name: Enrich predictions with match-level xG
steps.about: Adds each finished match's shot-based xG to predictions.parquet

steps.name: Build chain parquets (one league at a time)
steps.about: Runs scripts/build_chains_ci.R: builds the possession-chain files (chains-<league>.parquet, plus the newest seasons separately), downloading each league's events as it goes

steps.name: Build player-positions parquet (detailed pos for blog filter)
steps.about: Runs scripts/build_player_positions.R: each player's detailed position (left back, centre mid and so on) per league and season, for the site's position filter

steps.name: Fetch current club squads
steps.about: Downloads squads.parquet (who is at each club now) from opta-latest so the site's team column is current

steps.name: Recent predictions
steps.about: Writes predictions-recent.parquet: only the last 450 days of predictions, so the site's matches pages load faster

steps.name: Lock pre-match predictions
steps.about: Runs scripts/lock_predictions.R: keeps each match's last prediction made before its match day in predictions-locked.parquet (read from R2, added to, never rewritten)

steps.name: Simulate cup competitions (UCL/UEL/UECL)
steps.about: Runs scripts/simulate_cup.R: simulates the Champions League, Europa League and Conference League from the latest predictions, as cup-simulations.parquet

steps.name: Build per-player, per-team and per-league copies of match-stats and game-logs
steps.about: Runs scripts/by_player.R: re-sorts the match-stats and game-logs files by player and by team so a player or team page reads one small slice instead of the whole league

steps.name: Strip oversized R metadata from parquets
steps.about: Rewrites any parquet whose footer is over 1 MB so browsers do not have to download a huge header first

steps.name: Upload to R2
steps.about: Installs wrangler, uploads every parquet (and the small JSON files) to the inthegame-data bucket's football folder, then writes r2_bus_manifest.json last; fails before the manifest if any upload failed

steps.name: Fail run if expected blog artifacts are missing
steps.about: After the upload, ends the run red if any file that is rebuilt every run is missing (ratings, player details, match-shots and the match-stats files)

steps.name: Fail run if chains had per-comp failures
steps.about: After the upload, ends the run red if any competition's chain file failed to build (the others were still uploaded)
